items.title: Process models export to PowerPoint
items.body: Export a discovered L1 to L5 process model as a deck, next to the Signavio package.

items.title: The happy path in conformance
items.body: Conformance now shows the most common route through a process and the share of cases that follow it.

items.title: Live progress on runs and extractions
items.body: The run and extraction pages show a progress bar while the job is running, so you no longer need to refresh.

items.title: Insights and reports
items.body: New executive, forecast, impact and trend pages, with a board PDF and an analyst workbook behind them.

items.title: Rules know what is unmaintained
items.body: A field that nobody fills in is now reported once as not applicable, instead of as one defect per record.

items.title: Skip reasons are specific
items.body: When a rule is skipped, the run says why: missing table, missing field or not applicable to your configuration.

items.title: Rule coverage across the SAP landscape
items.body: Rules now cover the data dictionary for ECC, S/4HANA and the cloud systems, with checks that read the loaded configuration.

items.title: Layout and density
items.body: A tighter layout with a density choice, and a redesigned shell.
